::: {.rs-intro .sw-intro}
::: {.rs-lede}
Documented model frameworks associated with published and accepted research. Each repository gives the model formulation with references to the source equations, describes the data pipeline and the input formats, and includes a runnable implementation with examples on synthetic data and tests.

::: {.sw-cta}

:::
:::

::: {.sw-facts}
[9]{.sf-n}[framework repositories]{.sf-l}

[Python]{.sf-n}[3.10 or later, pip or conda]{.sf-l}

[HiGHS]{.sf-n}[open solver by default for the optimization models; Gurobi optional]{.sf-l}
:::

### Nuclear–hydrogen integration framework

[Henryutd2021/nuclear-hydrogen-integration]{.repo-slug}

Hourly operation and sizing of a nuclear plant with high-temperature electrolysis, hydrogen storage and batteries, selling energy, hydrogen and ancillary services, linked to a lifecycle cash-flow model with federal tax credits. Includes the article's 2024 PJM price inputs (PJM data, under PJM's terms of use); the other examples run on synthetic data.

::: {.repo-papers}
[Accompanies]{.label}

- [Nature Communications (2026)](projects/npph2.qmd)
:::

::: {.repo-tools}
[Python]{.chip} [linopy]{.chip} [HiGHS]{.chip} [Gurobi (optional)]{.chip}
:::

::: {.repo-actions}
[<i class="bi bi-github" aria-hidden="true"></i> GitHub](https://github.com/Henryutd2021/nuclear-hydrogen-integration){.btn-outline .btn-sm-x}

[<i class="bi bi-table" aria-hidden="true"></i> PJM 2024 data](https://github.com/Henryutd2021/nuclear-hydrogen-integration/tree/main/data/pjm){.btn-quiet}

### SMR cogeneration framework

[Henryutd2021/smr-datacenter-cogeneration]{.repo-slug}

A small modular reactor that supplies a data center with power and, through turbine steam extraction to an absorption chiller, with cooling: hourly co-optimization of reactor output, cooling and grid exchange, cost accounting and break-even metrics.

::: {.repo-papers}
[Accompanies]{.label}

- [Energy Conversion and Management (2026, accepted)](projects/nuclear-dc.qmd)
:::

### CoDE framework

[Henryutd2021/code-delayed-energization]{.repo-slug}

The cost of delayed energization for AI data centers, kept in separate developer, ratepayer and social accounts, with the delay cost intensity and the break-even acceleration payment as metrics.

### TXH2 framework

[Henryutd2021/txh2-ercot-hydrogen]{.repo-slug}

Two-stage stochastic planning of electrolyzers, hydrogen storage and fuel cells with inter-zonal hydrogen transport, under uncertain renewable build-out and electricity demand.

### Wind UQ surrogate framework

[Henryutd2021/wind-uq-surrogate]{.repo-slug}

Uncertainty metrics of a wind power model's inputs, calibrated uncertainty targets at observed plants, and surrogate models validated on held-out plants, for plant-level power uncertainty where no measurements exist. Since v1.1.0, a public-data case study of 264 ERCOT wind plants (ARPA-E PERFORM, simulated plant power).

::: {.repo-papers}
[Accompanies]{.label}

- [DOE-funded project (no paper)](projects/national-wind-uq.qmd)
:::

::: {.repo-tools}
[Python]{.chip} [NumPy]{.chip} [SciPy]{.chip} [scikit-learn]{.chip}
:::

[<i class="bi bi-github" aria-hidden="true"></i> GitHub](https://github.com/Henryutd2021/wind-uq-surrogate){.btn-outline .btn-sm-x}

### MF-GPR framework

[Henryutd2021/mfgpr-wind-power-curve]{.repo-slug}

Multi-fidelity Gaussian process regression for probabilistic wind power curves, fusing the theoretical curve of the turbine type with measured operating records.

::: {.repo-papers}
[Accompanies]{.label}

- [ASME IDETC 2023](projects/uq-mfgpr.qmd)

::: {.dn-body}
[Data availability]{.dn-title}

The repositories present the modelling frameworks. They do not contain the code, the input data or the results used for the published articles. For the data and code of individual studies, see each paper's data availability statement.
